title: Integral lattice and finite-free compact-support model on a curve
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$ and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$. Let $X_0$ be separated of finite type over $k_0$ with $\dim X_0\le1$, and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. The integral category and its rationalization are [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Let $K_E\in D^b_c(X,E)$ be an object which is a sheaf in degree zero for the standard pair of [def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure] (no Weil structure is used), and let $K_{\mathcal O}\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ together with an isomorphism $\alpha:K_{\mathcal O}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_E$ of $D^b_c(X,E)$ be any integral lattice of $K_E$ (for instance $K_{\mathcal O}=K_E$, $\alpha=\mathrm{id}$). No finite-level hypothesis (etale-origin witness or admissibility) is assumed for the reductions of $K_{\mathcal O}$. Set $C=\mathcal H^0(K_{\mathcal O})$, $D=\bigcup_{n\ge1}\ker(\varpi^n:C\to C)$ and $M=C/D$, regarded as sheaves of modules over the completed coefficient sheaf of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Then $D$ is killed by a single power of $\varpi$, $M$ is a constructible integral sheaf on which multiplication by $\varpi$ is injective, and $K_E\simeq M[1/\varpi]$ in $D^b_c(X,E)$. The derived reductions of $M$ are the underived sheaves $M_n=M/\varpi^nM$, they lie in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$ and admit explicit etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and their quotient-induced transitions form a normalized system [def-trf-adic-system]. Moreover, for the compact-support functor [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], $P=R\Gamma_c(X,M)$ is represented by a bounded complex of finite free $\mathcal O_E$-modules, with
$$P\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_n\simeq R\Gamma_c(X,M_n),\qquad H_c^i(X,K_E)\simeq H^i(P)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E\quad(n\ge1,\ i\in\mathbf Z).$$
No Weil structure on $M$ is asserted.
